source: [in awe] Look up. These are the Training Grounds — and every obelisk rises exactly as high as the skill it guards. TypeScript. React and Next.js. Java. Git. [excited] The tallest stones of all — sharpened on real products, long nights... and a truly heroic amount of debugging. [warmly] But his real strength? It's the way he works with people — calm under pressure, and always ready to lead.
